runs.label: Qwen 3.8 27B (0.32+MTP)
runs.variant: qwen/qwen3.8-27b (model_id recorded in every file); quantization not recorded
runs.gpu: single GPU, asserted by operator, not recorded in result files
runs.vllm_image: not recorded - operator reports a vLLM 0.32 server; bench client image newer than v0.25.0, tag not captured
runs.serve_config: NOT RECORDED - must be recovered from the deployment (see docs/caveats.md)
runs.bench_flags: vllm bench serve --dataset-name random --num-prompts 100 --backend vllm (endpoint_type=vllm -> /v1/completions; the 2026-08 runs used --backend openai)
runs.notes: PROVISIONAL n=1. Three things changed at once vs 2026-08-04: model (3.6 -> 3.8), engine (0.2x -> 0.32), and speculative decoding is now active (3 draft tokens, acceptance length 2.17-3.21, acceptance rate 39-74%). The decode gain is spec decode, not the engine: median ITL per step ROSE 25-43% while TPOT per accepted token fell 41-64%. Prefill gain (~1.9x, TTFT slope 4.11 -> ~1.6-2.2 ms/token) is not spec-decode related. max_output_tokens_per_s in these files is broken (below average output_throughput in 13/16 files) and is deliberately not ingested.
